text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are heavy... but don't widen your stride!
Keep turning your legs over! As fast as possible!!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I can do this... if I just maintain this speed! Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe! Still maintaining top speed... But!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even faster—that is who I am!
Therefore, I am top speed!! Taaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O takes first place!
Once again, an arrow of light pierces through Niigata!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOHHH!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Right O, where are you going!?
You've already crossed the finish line!

Even after passing the goal post, Calstone Light O
rounded the corner and kept on running
for a while...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... wheeze... haa...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: W-Welcome back... That was quite the long winning run, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I... I thought I could reach it, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It'll reach...? 
But... you're the one who won.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was... so close.
Just a little more... and I would've made it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Into... that light............ *hack* *cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Are you all right? Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, there's no need... *cough* to worry!
I'll slowly head, *hack*! back on my own...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, um...
We need to go to the Winner's Circle, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
Please tell us how you feel right now
after conquering the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*chug chug chug chug*... Pwah!
So delicious!!
Nothing beats a drink after a race!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Ah!
What kind of thoughts led to such
a long victory lap?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I haven't done a victory lap, though?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I see...
Then lastly, a quick word for all your fans!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, the atmosphere at the racetrack is truly special.
Everyone's cheers contribute to my speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next time, even faster!
I'll keep beating my top speed!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just how fast can you get?!
Show us what you've got, Calstone Light O!
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, I'll show that I can fulfill my duty.

Back in the waiting room, I asked Calstone Light O
why she had kept running even after crossing the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Because it felt like I could almost reach the light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight... after feeling Believe,
it felt like I was running while floating in midair."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Though her legs must have felt heavy, her turnover didn't stop,
and she kept running. As if someone were pushing her from behind.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And up ahead... I saw a light.
It felt like if I just kept running, I could reach it.
All the way to the other side of that light...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, when my speed dropped,
the light moved farther away as well.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it just like during the Ibis Summer Dash?
From the unique excitement of a race,
she was able to unleash power beyond her usual..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Official races possess a mysterious power.
That is particularly prominent in GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Did Bakushin O have a similar experience?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "I certainly do! The cheers from all my fans and running alongside my rivals gave me strength!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To me in particular,
having rivals made a massive difference!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I challenged her wanting to win, but at her preferred distance, I was turned away time and again. Though I refused to yield, just as she did.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat Flight-san—
that desire became my greatest fuel.
And fueled by that flame, I kept running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is a strength that can only be unlocked
by clashing fiercely against your rival...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...On the flip side, lacking rivals
can sometimes extinguish one's inner fire, but..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, the reason I felt Believe's presence so strongly today of all days was...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Rivals are necessary to reach top speed.
When Trainer told me that before,
I simply took it at face value, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Today, however, I truly felt it...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Competition... Battles against rivals
are essential to becoming faster!”

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Then for my next race, I want to compete against fast opponents!
Umamusume who can race for top speed with me, just like today!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to run in another GⅠ race next time too!
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for back-to-back Spring and Autumn Sprint G1 titles.

text_block_list.text: The Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs—the Takamatsunomiya Kinen in spring, and the Sprinters Stakes in autumn. Currently, these are the only two turf sprint GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Which means the spring Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If you conquer both the Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs, you'll be the fastest sprint Umamusume in both name and reality!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us reach the pinnacle of speed
in the Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs!
That night, aboard the Shinkansen on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, what a coincidence.
Though the timing is actually perfect.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm running in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
I want to race against you once more there!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: With... me?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Competing against you will make me even faster.
I might become faster than I can even imagine!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go beyond the light I saw today.
I want to reach the very frontier of speed!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can reach it if I'm with you.
So this is just a selfish request of mine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe, let's run in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, it is a rather selfish request.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However... just as you aim for maximum speed,
I will deliver a perfected run on the stage
that demands the highest level of mastery.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"...
That's one of the spring/autumn sprint GⅠs. You too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we share the same path.
You and I will compete once again right there.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: At the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...I won't lose next time. I will bring together the pinnacle of technique and put on a flawless run."
